project: H-1234 174,000 m3 LNG carrier (fictional sample data)
contract_rule_summary: Items explicitly written in the Contract Specification are Builder's scope at contract price.
Requests beyond the Specification are Owner's changes: Builder quotes cost and schedule impact; a Variation Order (VO) is issued before implementation.
Clarifications, typos and confirmations do not change scope and carry no cost.
Any change affecting structural scantlings, stability, or cargo containment requires re-approval by the Classification Society.

spec_baseline.Spec Part I 1.4: Damage stability per IGC Code only.
spec_baseline.Spec Part II 2.1: Scantlings per Class rules including rule corrosion additions.
spec_baseline.Spec Part II 3.2.4: One provision crane, port side, SWL 5 t.
spec_baseline.Spec Part III 5.1.2: Secondary barrier insulation 270 mm; guaranteed BOR 0.10 %/day.
spec_baseline.Spec Part III 6.2: Cargo compressor foundations per Builder's standard, vibration analysis by Builder.
spec_baseline.Spec Part IV 2.7: One HFO purifier for auxiliary engines plus duplex filter.
spec_baseline.Spec Part V 4.3: Mess room furniture: Builder's standard laminate finish; 'similar equipment' clause covers make substitution of equal quality, not material upgrade.
